title: Operation Document (v1)
description: Immutable typed operations document persisted by the agent service document repository (SPEC-039 R-1). Documents are snapshots: digest values are copied verbatim from the durable stores at assembly time, record ids are provenance anchors (never live references), and publishing is a one-way draft->published lifecycle. No model output appears outside the labeled prose section.

document_type.description: Typed-document discriminator; shift_summary ships in Phase 1 (SPEC-039 R-3). Future types extend this enum without touching the substrate.

state.description: Lifecycle state. Drafts are visible only to the owner; published documents are visible to every documents:read holder (SPEC-039 R-2).

owner_user_id.description: The user who generated the document; the only identity that may edit (publish), delete, or see it while drafted.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of publishing; null while drafted.

session_id.description: A covered session; the provenance index is the future entry point for cross-owner review.

coverage.description: owner: full digest tier; foreign: metadata-only tier behind approvals:list (SPEC-039 R-3).

cited_record_ids.description: Record ids copied into the digest (confirmation ids, execution ids); anchors, not live references.

provenance.description: Provenance block listing covered session ids and cited record ids.

digest.description: Type-specific deterministic digest copied verbatim from the durable stores (shift_summary: sessions, confirmation decisions, execution receipts, evidence counts, open items). Never model output.

prose.description: Optional clearly-labeled generated narrative produced from the digest JSON alone (SPEC-039 R-4); null unless prose_status is included.

prose_status.description: Prose layer outcome; a model error or timeout yields failed and a digest-only document.
